stage: Post-aggregated-outcome descriptive sensitivity. All six previously published shared-gridmonth contrasts and all four taxa are fixed BEFORE opening new geographic-block and day/night component outcomes.
biological_question: When animal source cohorts share the same 1-degree geographic grid and year-month, are their relative night-versus-day GPS movement-speed differences accounted for by daytime or nighttime speeds, and are differences stable when geographic cells rather than successive months receive equal weight?
replicated_sample_policy: Keep the exact previous source-gated cell x year-month roster: for each taxon, only animal-calendar-years with >=10 solar days having >=3 GPS valid 0.5–2 h intervals in BOTH solar day and night; accept a taxon cell-year-month only when >=3 animals each have >=3 eligible local dates. No source or threshold tuning after seeing signs.
outcome: Within source taxon pair, compare equal-animals log1p(median night GPS speed), log1p(median day GPS speed) and q=night−day on the identical admitted grid-months. Report q_a−q_b, night_a−night_b, day_a−day_b and exact algebra.
spatial_block: Treat the same 1-degree geographic grid recurring in different months/years as one spatial block. For each block mean all its admitted grid-month contrasts equally; then average blocks equally. Report distinct grid blocks, year-month units, and day/night components. Leave-one-spatial-grid ranges describe finite-sample influence, NOT inferential confidence intervals.
uncertainty: If >=5 distinct 1-degree geographic blocks, perform deterministic (seed 20261019) 2000 draw nonparametric geographic-block bootstrap for 95% percentile interval of mean q difference. This is conditional on these coarse sampled spatial blocks, not on independently sampled ecosystems, shared recruitment or between-taxon behavioral causation. If fewer than 5 blocks, interval unavailable.
ethics: No precise animal GPS coordinates, animal IDs, individual-level source values, exact dates or cell keys exported. Output only group aggregate grid-count, year-count and species source contrasts. Provider CC0 source attribution and original MD5 retained.
status_rule: First reproduce the exact six original 1-degree × year-month taxon contrasts and support counts at <=1e-11 numeric tolerance. Abort source analysis if any original result differs. Do not reopen a failed original spring/autumn matched-photoperiod branch; this remains a separate diel observation study.
